rationale: The plan addresses the finance objective by grouping claims by specialty to compare volume, spend totals, averages, and denial rates over adjudicated claims only (correcting the denominator per feedback). Small-group flagging (threshold: 30 claims) highlights low-volume specialties. Provider ranking identifies the top 10 rendering providers by highest paid spend, excluding low-volume providers. Report generation includes appropriate caveats for synthetic data and descriptive analysis, with denominators shown for rate interpretation and source citations for reproducibility.
changes_summary: Changed group_comparison denominator parameter from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' to correctly calculate per-specialty denial rates. Denial rates must use only adjudicated claims in the denominator because non-adjudicated claims cannot have a denial or fraud outcome; including them distorts rate calculations. This corrects the specialty denial-rate calculations while keeping all other components and parameters unchanged.
